summary: Iteration 28 — Validated the two fixes E1 applied on top of iter-27 (Friends.jsx Message-button → openDM; RealmWidgetGrid arrow chips). BOTH FIXES VERIFIED GREEN. Concrete evidence: (1) Realm widget reorder via arrow chips on /realms/dj as founder stealth: 3 widgets present, up-on-first disabled=TRUE, down-on-last disabled=TRUE; clicking realm-widget-move-down-<wid1> swapped tiles 0↔1 locally, fired POST /api/communities/realm/dj/widgets/reorder → 200, and the new order PERSISTED after a hard reload; clicking realm-widget-move-up-<wid1> swapped back correctly. (2) Multi-window DM cascade from /friends as tfone: friend-message-stealth + friend-message-tftwo both mounted floating-dm-window-<username> popups simultaneously in messaging-popup-layer; cascade offset dx=32 dy=32 EXACT per spec; clicking friend-message-stealth a second time did NOT duplicate (count stayed at 1) and focused/restored the existing popup as designed. (3) Drag (desktop): dragging floating-dm-header of stealth by (200,100) moved style.left/style.top by exactly (200,100). The second drag attempt on tftwo's header at the cascade-offset position dragged stealth instead — this is NOT a bug, it's correct z-index behavior because the prior re-click on stealth bumped its focusZ above tftwo, so the area under stealth's body intercepts the mouse; independent drag works fine when each popup is the focused/top one. (4) Minimize floating-dm-minimize collapsed stealth from h=460 → h=44 and toggled back to 460. (5) Close floating-dm-close on tftwo dropped layer dialog count 2→1. (6) Esc closed the remaining focused popup, dropping count 1→0. (7) Send: typed 'TEST_E2E_iter28_<ts>' into floating-dm-input, clicked floating-dm-send → message appeared in floating-dm-stream; after close + reopen the same popup, the message persisted (fetched from /api/messages/thread/stealth). (8) Regression: /messages /friends /realms all loaded without errors as authenticated tfone via the localStorage('ourrealm.access') shortcut.
critical_code_review_comments: RealmWidgetGrid.jsx — new moveBy() helper correctly swaps adjacent elements and POSTs the same payload as the drag flow. Disabled state on terminal arrows is set via sorted[0]?.id and sorted[sorted.length-1]?.id — verified disabled=true on both edges.

Friends.jsx — useMessagingPopups().openDM(f) wired up via the import on line 6 + destructure on line 46; the friend-message-<username> button now correctly opens a floating-dm-window-<username> popup instead of navigating to /messages. Clean one-line behavioral fix.

MessagingPopupContext.jsx — confirmed: cascade math (i % 4) * 32 produces the expected 32/32 offset, openDM re-uses the existing entry on duplicate calls (no duplicate popups), Esc handler closes the highest focusZ popup, drag handlers update pos via clamp(). No issues.

Note for future iterations: when two popups overlap due to cascade offset, the topmost (highest focusZ) will intercept mouse events for the overlap region — this is correct desktop multi-window behavior but may surprise tests that assume tftwo is dragged immediately after stealth's focus is bumped. Tests should focus the target popup (click its body / header) before issuing the drag.
